title: [BUG] out dated documentation about slash commands https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/slash-commands#namespacing
body:
The official docs still discuss the old name spacing of slash commands: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/slash-commands#namespacing

ie. Structure: <prefix>:<namespace>:<command> 
the <prefix> is not longer needed
